comment: Recognition layer 2: community signs. Coordinates are real OSM lat/lon, projected via route origin+scale at load. radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. needs_owner_review = true flags entries where map data alone is uncertain — owner's lived knowledge is authoritative.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow spit connecting the airport to the mainland — coconut trees, sea on both sides

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Community at the Harbour View roundabout — gateway from the Palisadoes into Kingston

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Inner-city Kingston neighbourhood along Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside Rastafari community overlooking Mountain View — exact trigger position may need adjustment

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital city — route threads through Windward Road, Mountain View, Half Way Tree

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: Major commercial hub and transport centre of uptown Kingston

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Corporate/hotel district — overlaps with Half Way Tree; owner should decide if both signs are wanted

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: St Catherine parish capital and former colonial capital of Jamaica

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Community at the entrance to the Bog Walk Gorge and Flat Bridge

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: St Catherine market town — famous for ackee and the song Linstead Market

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: St Ann plateau junction — where the route begins its descent toward Ocho Rios

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival; a standing institution

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Dense fern-canopied gully road descending into Ocho Rios — Milford Road through the gully

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: St Ann Bay resort town — journey's end, Dunn's River Falls
